name: Honda Rebel 250
engine: 234 cc air-cooled parallel twin, one carb
intro: The classic small Rebel. One carb, chain drive and drum rear brake. Very common as a first bike.

G: Most no-starts on a stored Rebel 250 come from a clogged pilot jet. Clean it first.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.
